description: The plot illustrates training loss as it changes with training steps for several different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2000, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. There are five lines shown on the plot. A solid red line, labeled “Vanilla”, starts at approximately 1.18 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.12 at step 2000. A dashed green line, labeled “Sep1_LLM(n=380)”, starts at approximately 1.18 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.28 at step 2000. A dashed-dotted blue line, labeled “Sep1_LLM(n=256)”, starts at approximately 1.18 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.32 at step 2000. A solid purple line, labeled “Sep1_LLM(n=64)”, starts at approximately 1.18 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.48 at step 2000. Finally, a solid orange line, labeled “Sep1_LLM(n=128)”, starts at approximately 1.18 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.40 at step 2000.
